1. Go to **Settings** > **Custom fields**.
2. Select **Add custom field**.
3. Enter a **Label**.
4. In **Applies to**, choose **Companies**.
5. For **Type**, choose **Dropdown**, then enter one option per line in **Options**.
6. Select **Save field**.

The field appears on every company, in the edit form and on the company's page. Note that you can't change the **Type** or **Applies to** after the field is created, but you can rename it or edit its options later.
